name: olivers-table-nov
note: OLIVER'S TABLE AS IT SAT ON 2026-11-10 (captain's log goblin-storm 004-005, sharknado 008): four players -- Sean, Oliver, Tom, Ryan -- an optimized bracket-3 table aiming to win around turn four, by the pilot's notes. Built 2026-11-11 for edgar-vampires' threat-v1 A/B, whose pre-registered primary is forge.life_removed_total; the comparison is PAIRED (same seeds, same table), so the table's own null is not what the verdict reads. Every seat is an EDHREC average list standing in for a real deck: Oliver brought Balin and Krenko (Krenko seated, game 3's killer); Tom's deck is now confirmed as Purphoros (purphoros-pingers, which owned olivers-table in its first run, 25 of 40 against sharknado v2.0.0); Ryan brought Tiny Bones, which has no seat, so teval-graveyard -- his bracket-4 deck at this table on 2026-10-20 -- stands in. NEVER PLAYED in simulation until the edgar A/A; `pods olivers-table-nov --calibration` after.

seats.note: Oliver, 2026-11-10 game 3: Krenko landed, went unanswered, and dealt Sean 30-plus in one turn (sharknado 008). The EDHREC average stands in for his list; its bracket is the average list's floor.
seats.engine_why: data/opponents/krenko-tokens/NOTES.md: Krenko doubles goblins each activation, then pings and an alpha strike; Bombardment and Skirk Prospector are the outlets, Impact Tremors the ping, the lords the swing. Read off the list before any audit named them.

seats.note: Tom, confirmed on Purphoros 2026-11-10 (goblin-storm 004-005: turn-one Sol Ring, turn-two Purphoros). The EDHREC average stands in for his list.
seats.engine_why: data/opponents/purphoros-pingers/NOTES.md: every creature entering is 2 to each opponent; tokens are burn. Same engine list as olivers-table's seat. Read off the list before any audit named them.

seats.note: Ryan's stand-in: he brought Tiny Bones on 2026-11-10, which has no seat (`fetch-opponent` on the pilot's word); Teval is his bracket-4 deck at this table on 2026-10-20.
seats.engine_why: data/opponents/teval-graveyard/NOTES.md, as in olivers-table. Read off the list before any audit named them.
